title: Wood Fired Penne Pasta
description: A rustic Italian dish featuring penne pasta baked to perfection in a wood-fired oven. This recipe combines the smoky flavors of the oven with the simplicity of a classic pasta dish.
instructions: Cook penne pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large bowl, combine cooked pasta, olive oil, chopped basil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add halved cherry tomatoes to the bowl and toss to combine.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a Dutch oven or a large cast-iron skillet.
Bake in the wood-fired oven for 10-12 minutes or until the pasta is lightly browned and the flavors have melded together.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with additional basil if desired.
Optional: Top with grated Parmesan cheese for added flavor.
